Temporary traffic changes around the University of Wollongong and TAFE NSW will be in place from Monday 3 March to Friday 11 April 2025, to minimise congestion for the start of the university year. 

The temporary traffic changes are as follows:

  • Traffic exiting the M1 Motorway southbound at University Ave, will be diverted left to make a U-turn at the eastern roundabout. University-bound motorists will then be detoured to the Southern (previously Western) access route via Murphys Avenue and Robsons Road. 
  • Northbound M1 Motorway motorists using the Gwynneville exit will detour to the roundabout at Northfields Avenue to access Irvine Street.  
  • Motorists wishing to access the M1 northbound from Keiraville and Gwynneville are encouraged to do so from Robsons Road at West Wollongong to avoid delays.

Bus access from University Avenue into Irvine Street will not be affected during diversions. Outside peak periods traffic will continue to access the University via Irvine Street and Northfields Avenue.

Traffic controllers will be on site to direct motorists.

Changed traffic conditions in place:

  • Two lanes of traffic will be maintained in each direction on President Ave;
  • No right turn at President Ave at Cross St; and
  • No right turn at President Ave at Oakdale Ave.

Access to Moorefield Estate will be maintained from President Ave (eastbound) via Traynor Ave.

properties.otherAdvice:
Traffic will be switched on the new Parkes Bypass from Tuesday 15 April.

Access to the Bypass from Parkes is via Condobolin Road roundabout.

The existing Newell Highway will be closed between Barkers Road and Saleyards Road.

At the completion of the access works, both the current Newell Highway and the new Bypass will be open to traffic.

arrangementElements.html:
The OSOM route will be the new Parkes Bypass.

OSOM vehicles travelling east from the Newell Highway will take the new Parkes Bypass to the Condobolin Road roundabout (exit west) and travel via the new alignment of Hartigan Avenue.

The rest area adjacent to Saleyards Rd will be closed. Access will be returned after 6 weeks. For more information on available Rest Areas visit the Rest Areas Map.

Special event clearways will be in place continuously from 2am Sat 26 Apr to 2am Mon 28 Apr to facilitate rail replacement bus operations for Sydney Trains trackwork.

Clearways are strict no-parking zones for all vehicle types, and apply even to local residents and businesses with parking permits or TfNSW Mobility Scheme permit holders. If your vehicle is towed, you can search your vehicle registration at the Find My Car website to find its new location, or alternatively call 132 701 to speak to an operator.

The Pacific Highway between Masonite Road and Richardson Road will have a single lane closure and oversize/over mass (OSOM) restrictions will be in place in the remaining lane. A holding area will be provided immediately north of Kingston Parade, Heatherbrae for OSOM vehicles with ground contact width greater than 3.2 metres and/or width greater than 4.5 metres. 


Once stopped in holding bay, call the site on UHF Channel 24 or call 0428 066 844 as shown on signage provided, to confirm arrangements for travelling through the work area.
